status: DRAFT for review. Not wired into the wizard. No database changes required or applied. Platform facts re-verified 2026-10-15 against migrations 037, 173 and 180 and the live database.
notes: A preset is a bundle of wizard defaults. Adding a preset = one entry here, reviewed by PR.
Legal type is stored separately and never changes wizard steps.
Existing platform concepts stay as they are: Contributor, Place, Event. Presets do not add a fourth entity.
The wizard already asks for a primary category first. category_default_preset (below) picks the default preset from that answer; the user may override it.
Capabilities in deferred_capabilities are NOT built for v1. Presets reference them only under planned_capabilities.
Required fields stay minimal: name + category, plus a date for events.

existing_platform_facts_verified_2026_10.contributor_go_live: Self-serve apply since migration 164, but since D-12 (migration 180) an applicant waits for an admin to approve: their Dashboard works at once and nothing of theirs is public until approval. Founder can hide a listing via set_contributor_hidden.
existing_platform_facts_verified_2026_10.contributor_kind_gap: 'individual' has been allowed by the CHECK constraint since migration 173, but the Apply wizard does not ask for the kind yet (pipeline item C3).
existing_platform_facts_verified_2026_10.citizen_events: Migration 037 rate-limits citizen (non-contributor) public events to 1 per 30 days (app_settings community_event_rate_limit, read live 2026-10-15). Confirm the limit matches the intended 'citizens can post their own events'.
existing_platform_facts_verified_2026_10.recurrence_in_prod: 0 recurring events exist (live 2026-10-15: 0 of 4 events); recurring_pattern jsonb shape is not yet defined. The create wizard's 'upcomingDates' field is marked DEFER TO V2.

day_one_capabilities.registration_link: no dedicated column. Options: reuse website_url, or add a details jsonb (proposal, not applied)
day_one_capabilities.route_link: no dedicated column. Same options as registration_link
day_one_capabilities.recurrence: existing columns is_recurring + recurring_pattern; wizard UI not yet built

deferred_capabilities: volunteer_roles_and_requirements (a simple volunteer_openings toggle already exists)

listing_policy.citizen_event: Goes live immediately. Rate limit (migration 037) and report/flag path apply.
listing_policy.self_serve: Contributor applies at once but waits for admin approval (D-12, migration 180); nothing is public until approved. Founder can hide.
listing_policy.self_serve_flagged: Same approval gate as self_serve (D-12), so an admin sees these listings before they go public. OPEN DECISION for founder: whether Care/Recovery and child-facing Education need a further hold or review step beyond that approval. Safeguarding fields are required either way. Discovery routine must never auto-publish these.

care_recovery.label: Care / Recovery
care_recovery.gallery_rule: No photos of identifiable clients or minors without documented consent.

education.label: Education
education.gallery_rule: No photos of children without documented consent.

gathering_market.label: Gathering / Market
deferred_subtypes: dating_event (waits for age_restriction and host verification)

roaming_route_event.label: Roaming / Route Event
roaming_route_event.wizard_note: Today's event wizard requires a venue address. This preset needs a start-point-only path so roaming and route events can be created.

category_default_preset.note: Maps the existing categories (CATEGORIES.md) to a default preset so the wizard needs no separate 'pick a type' step.

fallback_preset.note: Used when nothing fits. Free tags only. The discovery routine logs these as gap candidates.
